data: Ovaj simbol grada Rijeke bio je dekapitiran 1919. i sljedećih stotinjak godina smatrao se uništenim. A onda je nestalu glavu na zidu dvorišta Vittoriale degli Italiani pronašao talijanski povjesničar Federico Carlo Simonelli. Dokumentarni film donosi do sada nikada ispričanu priču o orlu i D’Annunziju, iz perspektive obiju strana, hrvatskih i talijanskih stručnjaka. (When world-famous photographer Thomas Hoepker was diagnosed with Alzheimer's Disease, he and his wife decided to take a road trip across the U.S., his home for 40 years. An emotional journey in historic times.)

Dokumentarni film donosi do sada nikada ispričanu priču o orlu i D’Annunziju, iz perspektive obiju strana, hrvatskih i talijanskih stručnjaka.

When world-famous photographer Thomas Hoepker was diagnosed with Alzheimer's Disease, he and his wife decided to take a road trip across the U.S., his home for 40 years. An emotional journey in historic times.
